### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the new scope, model preset, or engineering calculation you would like added.

### Engineering & Scope Basis
- Target Asset Type: [e.g. Tailings Storage Facility (TSF), Smelter Demolition, Substation Decommissioning, Housing Village]
- Estimated Surface Footprint: [e.g. m² or Hectares]
- Key Quantities: [e.g. Concrete volume m³, Structural steel count, Rubble tonnage]
- Contract Standards: [e.g. JBCC, NEC3/4, FIDIC, Custom Client SOW]

### Commercial Rationale
Why is this model or enhancement needed? How does it improve commercial estimation or project execution?

### Additional Context
Add any other context, reference documents, or rate cards here.
